title: Remotion · Create videos with coding agents

application: Check available skills before adding another copy of the same procedure.
limits: Vendor workflow guidance; it does not prove a quality gain for every model or task, including Astra.

date: Updated 12 September 2026

title: OpenAI · Rethinking skills and prompts for GPT-6 Astra
date: Published 11 September 2026
summary: Reassess accumulated instructions when moving to Astra; elaborate procedures can constrain a stronger model.
Keep skill triggers precise and load supporting material only when relevant.
Replace blanket document-reading and repeated-testing demands with context-sensitive guidance.
application: Audit existing instructions before adding another skill.
limits: Practical guidance from Eric Provencher, not a controlled measurement of skill gains on Astra.

title: OpenAI · Building games with Astra
date: Published 4 September 2026
summary: Begin with the desired player experience and visual references.
The example uses TypeScript, Vite, and Three.js with inspectable game state.
Separate repeatable scene setup from tests that actually operate the controls.
application: Ground the game brief and verification plan in a current Astra example.
limits: Thomas Ricouard’s showcase is an implementation account; it does not establish typical success rates.

title: SkillAlchemy · Open-World Agent Skill Creation
date: Submitted 24 August 2026 · v1 reviewed
summary: Discovers task requirements and supporting external evidence before compiling a reusable skill.
Reports improvements over no-skill and automated-generation baselines on 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks.
Evaluations include GPT-5.5, Opus 4.8, and DeepSeek V4 configurations; none is Astra.
application: Treat evidence-led skill generation as a candidate worth testing.
limits: Preprint results do not show that casually generating a skill for any task will help.

title: MCP · Architecture, specification 2026-07-28
date: Specification version 28 July 2026 · not a page publication date
summary: An application hosts clients that connect to MCP servers.
Servers expose tools, resources, and prompts through a common protocol.
The protocol exchanges context; it does not dictate the agent’s planning strategy.
application: Separate a connection that enables actions from instructions that guide those actions.
limits: A conceptual architecture, not a video generator or an Astra performance evaluation.

title: SkillsBench · Agent leaderboard, v1.1
date: Leaderboard recomputed 16 July 2026 · underlying project began before March
summary: Compares skills and no-skills conditions across a broad collection of 87 tasks.
The reviewed table contains 24 paired agent–model configurations plus one with-skills-only result.
Curated skills often help, but the size of the benefit varies across configurations.
application: Useful counterevidence to the claim that all skills are redundant.
limits: The reviewed leaderboard has no Astra entry. Different harnesses and task mixes limit transfer to game development.

title: Runway · Multi-shot video recipe, 2026-06
date: Recipe version 2026-06 · page publication date not stated

The custom mode accepts a small set of shots with explicit timing.
Inputs must follow the recipe’s supported total duration and format.
application: A candidate API route for the original three-shot teaser storyboard.
limits: A recipe version is not a publication date or an assurance of consistent characters, exact gameplay, or Astra-specific gains.

title: SkillsInjector · Dynamic Skill Context Construction for LLM Agents

application: Evaluate which skill was selected as well as the final output.
limits: A proposed research method, not a feature claimed for Codex. The tested agents are not Astra.

title: Anthropic · Harness design for long-running application development

title: SWE-Skills-Bench · Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?
date: Submitted 16 March 2026 · v1 reviewed
summary: Evaluates 49 public software-engineering skills on roughly 565 tasks with executable acceptance checks.
Reports no gain for 39 of 49 skills and a small average improvement of about 1.2 percentage points.
Finds overhead and some regressions, including mismatches between advice and repository versions.
application: Keep a no-added-skill baseline and examine regressions, not just aggregate wins.
limits: Explicitly preliminary; uses Claude Code with Haiku 4.5, not Astra. Its setup differs from SkillsBench and Codex skill routing.

title: OpenAI · GPT-6 Astra prompting best practices

limits: Match the documentation to the installed Godot version. A tutorial does not evaluate an AI workflow.

title: Godot · Exporting for the Web
date: Stable documentation · publication/update date not stated

Browser input, audio, and hosting behavior require explicit attention.
application: Try a tiny export on the intended host before building the full game.
limits: Check the exact engine release. A model upgrade does not remove browser or hosting restrictions.

GitHub Pages project sites need a base path matching the repository name.
The guide provides a GitHub Actions deployment example.
